properties.name: Application
properties.description: When used without an object qualifier, this property returns an Application object that represents the Microsoft Excel application.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Returns a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which this object was created. Read-only Long.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns the parent object for the specified object. Read-only.

properties.name: Priority
properties.description: Returns or sets the priority value of the conditional formatting rule. The priority determines the order of evaluation when multiple conditional formatting rules exist on a worksheet.

properties.name: StopIfTrue
properties.description: Returns or sets a Boolean value that determines if additional formatting rules on the cell should be evaluated if the current rule evaluates to True.

properties.name: AppliesTo
properties.description: Returns a Range object specifying the cell range to which the formatting rule is applied.

properties.name: AboveBelow
properties.description: Returns or sets one of the constants of the XlAboveBelow enumeration, specifying if the conditional formatting rule looks for cell values above or below the range average or standard deviation.

properties.name: Interior
properties.description: Returns an Interior object that specifies a cell's interior attributes for a conditional formatting rule that evaluates to True. Read-only.

properties.name: Borders
properties.description: Returns a Borders collection that specifies the formatting of cell borders if the conditional formatting rule evaluates to True. Read-only.

properties.name: Font
properties.description: Returns a Font object that specifies the font formatting if the conditional formatting rule evaluates to True. Read-only.

properties.name: Type
properties.description: Returns one of the constants of the XlFormatConditionType enumeration, which specifies the type of conditional format. Read-only.

properties.name: NumberFormat
properties.description: Returns or sets the number format applied to a cell if the conditional formatting rule evaluates to True. Read/write Variant.

properties.name: PTCondition
properties.description: Returns a Boolean value indicating if the conditional format is being applied to a PivotTable. Read-only.

properties.name: ScopeType
properties.description: Returns or sets one of the constants of the XlPivotConditionScope enumeration, which determines the scope of the conditional format when it is applied to a PivotTable.

properties.name: CalcFor
properties.description: Returns or sets one of the constants of the XlCalcFor enumeration, which specifies the scope of data to be evaluated for the conditional format in a PivotTable report.

properties.name: NumStdDev
properties.description: Returns or sets the numeric standard deviation for an AboveAverage object. Read/write Long.

properties.name: Type
properties.description: Returns the action type. Read-only XlActionType.

properties.name: Coordinate

properties.name: Content
properties.description: Returns the content associated to the Action object. Read-only String.

properties.name: progID

properties.name: CLSID

properties.name: IsOpen

properties.description: Returns or sets the adjustment value specified by the Index argument. Read/write Single.

properties.name: Title
properties.description: Returns or sets the title of the range of cells that can edited on a protected sheet. Read/write String.

properties.name: Range
properties.description: Returns a Range object that represents a subset of the ranges that can be edited on a protected worksheet.

properties.name: Users
properties.description: Returns a UserAccessList object for the protected range on a worksheet.

properties.name: Application
properties.description: When used without an object qualifier, this property returns an Application object that represents the Microsoft Excel application.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Returns a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which this object was created. Read-only Long.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns the parent object for the specified object. Read-only.

properties.name: ActiveCell
properties.description: Returns a Range object that represents the active cell in the active window (the window on top) or in the specified window. If the window isn't displaying a worksheet, this property fails. Read-only.

properties.name: ActiveChart
properties.description: Returns a Chart object that represents the active chart (either an embedded chart or a chart sheet). An embedded chart is considered active when it's either selected or activated. When no chart is active, this property returns Nothing.

properties.name: ActivePrinter
properties.description: Returns or sets the name of the active printer. Read/write String.

properties.name: ActiveSheet
properties.description: Returns an object that represents the active sheet (the sheet on top) in the active workbook or in the specified window or workbook. Returns Nothing if no sheet is active.

properties.name: ActiveWindow
properties.description: Returns a Window object that represents the active Excel window (the window on top). Returns Nothing if there are no windows open. Read-only.

properties.name: ActiveWorkbook
properties.description: Returns a Workbook object that represents the workbook in the active window (the window on top). Returns Nothing if there are no windows open or if either the Info window or the Clipboard window is the active window. Read-only.

properties.name: AddIns
properties.description: Returns an AddIns collection that represents all the add-ins listed in the Add-Ins dialog box (Add-Ins command on the Developer tab). Read-only.

properties.name: Cells
properties.description: Returns a Range object that represents all the cells on the active worksheet. If the active document is not a worksheet, this property fails.

properties.name: Charts
properties.description: Returns a Sheets collection that represents all the chart sheets in the active workbook.

properties.name: Columns
properties.description: Returns a Range object that represents all the columns on the active worksheet. If the active document isn't a worksheet, the Columns property fails.

properties.name: CommandBars
properties.description: Returns a CommandBars object that represents the Microsoft Excel command bars. Read-only.

properties.name: DDEAppReturnCode
properties.description: Returns the application-specific DDE return code that was contained in the last DDE acknowledge message received by Microsoft Excel. Read-only Long.

properties.name: Names
properties.description: Returns a Names collection that represents all the names in the active workbook. Read-only Names object.

properties.name: Range
properties.description: Returns a Range object that represents a cell or a range of cells.

properties.name: Rows
properties.description: Returns a Range object that represents all the rows on the active worksheet. If the active document isn't a worksheet, the Rows property fails. Read-only Range object.

properties.name: Selection
properties.description: Returns the currently selected object on the active worksheet for an Application object. Returns Nothing if no objects are selected. Use the Select method to set the selection, and use the TypeName function to discover the kind of object that is selected.

properties.name: Sheets
properties.description: Returns a Sheets collection that represents all the sheets in the active workbook. Read-only Sheets object.

properties.name: ThisWorkbook
properties.description: Returns a Workbook object that represents the workbook where the current macro code is running. Read-only.

properties.name: Windows
properties.description: Returns a Windows collection that represents all the windows in all the workbooks. Read-only Windows object.

properties.name: Workbooks
properties.description: Returns a Workbooks collection that represents all the open workbooks. Read-only.

properties.name: WorksheetFunction
properties.description: Returns the WorksheetFunction object. Read-only.

properties.name: Worksheets
properties.description: For an Application object, returns a Sheets collection that represents all the worksheets in the active workbook.

properties.name: Excel4IntlMacroSheets
properties.description: Returns a Sheets collection that represents all the Microsoft Excel 4.0 international macro sheets in the specified workbook. Read-only.

properties.name: Excel4MacroSheets
properties.description: Returns a Sheets collection that represents all the Microsoft Excel 4.0 macro sheets in the specified workbook. Read-only.

properties.name: AlertBeforeOverwriting
properties.description: True if Microsoft Excel displays a message before overwriting nonblank cells during a drag-and-drop editing operation. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: AltStartupPath
properties.description: Returns or sets the name of the alternate startup folder. Read/write String.

properties.name: AskToUpdateLinks
properties.description: True if Microsoft Excel asks the user to update links when opening files with links. False if links are automatically updated with no dialog box. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: AutoCorrect
properties.description: Returns an AutoCorrect object that represents the Microsoft Excel AutoCorrect attributes. Read-only.

properties.name: Build
properties.description: Returns the Microsoft Excel build number. Read-only Long.

properties.name: CalculateBeforeSave
properties.description: True if workbooks are calculated before they're saved to disk (if the Calculation property is set to xlManual). This property is preserved even if you change the Calculation property. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: Calculation
properties.description: Returns or sets an XlCalculation value that represents the calculation mode.

properties.name: Caller
properties.description: Returns information about how Visual Basic was called (for more information, see the Remarks section).

properties.name: Caption
properties.description: Returns or sets a String value that represents the name that appears in the title bar of the main Microsoft Excel window.

properties.name: CellDragAndDrop
properties.description: True if dragging and dropping cells is enabled. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: ClipboardFormats
properties.description: Returns the formats that are currently on the Clipboard, as an array of numeric values. To determine whether a particular format is on the Clipboard, compare each element in the array with the appropriate constant listed in the Remarks section. Read-only Variant.

properties.name: DisplayClipboardWindow
properties.description: Returns True if the Microsoft Office Clipboard can be displayed. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: CommandUnderlines
properties.description: Returns or sets the state of the command underlines in Microsoft Excel for the Macintosh. Can be one of the constants of XlCommandUnderlines. Read/write Long.

properties.name: ConstrainNumeric
properties.description: True if handwriting recognition is limited to numbers and punctuation only. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: CopyObjectsWithCells
properties.description: True if objects are cut, copied, extracted, and sorted with cells. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: Cursor
properties.description: Returns or sets the appearance of the mouse pointer in Microsoft Excel. Read/write XlMousePointer.

properties.name: CustomListCount
properties.description: Returns the number of defined custom lists (including built-in lists). Read-only Long.

properties.name: CutCopyMode
properties.description: Returns or sets the status of Cut or Copy mode. Can be True, False, or an XLCutCopyMode constant, as shown in the following tables. Read/write Long.

properties.name: DataEntryMode
properties.description: Returns or sets Data Entry mode, as shown in the following table. When in Data Entry mode, you can enter data only in the unlocked cells in the currently selected range. Read/write Long.

properties.name: DefaultFilePath
properties.description: Returns or sets the default path that Microsoft Excel uses when it opens files. Read/write String.

properties.name: Dialogs
properties.description: Returns a Dialogs collection that represents all built-in dialog boxes. Read-only.

properties.name: DisplayAlerts
properties.description: True if Microsoft Excel displays certain alerts and messages while a macro is running. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: DisplayFormulaBar
properties.description: True if the formula bar is displayed. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: DisplayFullScreen
properties.description: True if Microsoft Excel is in full-screen mode. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: DisplayNoteIndicator
properties.description: True if cells containing notes display cell tips and contain note indicators (small dots in their upper-right corners). Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: DisplayCommentIndicator
properties.description: Returns or sets the way cells display comments and indicators. Can be one of the XlCommentDisplayMode constants.

properties.name: DisplayExcel4Menus
properties.description: True if Microsoft Excel displays version 4.0 menu bars. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: DisplayRecentFiles
properties.description: True if the list of recently used files is displayed in the UI. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: DisplayScrollBars
properties.description: True if scroll bars are visible for all workbooks. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: DisplayStatusBar
properties.description: True if the status bar is displayed. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: EditDirectlyInCell
properties.description: True if Microsoft Excel allows editing in cells. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: EnableAutoComplete
properties.description: True if the AutoComplete feature is enabled. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: EnableCancelKey
properties.description: Controls how Microsoft Excel handles Ctrl+Break (or Esc or Command+Period) user interruptions to the running procedure. Read/write XlEnableCancelKey.

properties.name: EnableSound
properties.description: True if sound is enabled for Microsoft Office. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: FileConverters
properties.description: Returns information about installed file converters. Returns null if there are no converters installed. Read-only Variant.

properties.name: FixedDecimal
properties.description: All data entered after this property is set to True will be formatted with the number of fixed decimal places set by the FixedDecimalPlaces property. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: FixedDecimalPlaces
properties.description: Returns or sets the number of fixed decimal places used when the FixedDecimal property is set to True. Read/write Long.

properties.name: Height
properties.description: Returns or sets a Double value that represents the height, in points, of the main application window.

properties.name: IgnoreRemoteRequests
properties.description: True if remote DDE requests are ignored. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: Interactive
properties.description: True if Microsoft Excel is in interactive mode; this property is usually True. If you set this property to False, Excel blocks all input from the keyboard and mouse (except input to dialog boxes that are displayed by your code). Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: International
properties.description: Returns information about the current country/region and international settings. Read-only Variant.

properties.name: Iteration
properties.description: True if Microsoft Excel uses iteration to resolve circular references. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: Left
properties.description: Returns or sets a Double value that represents the distance, in points, from the left edge of the screen to the left edge of the main Microsoft Excel window.

properties.name: LibraryPath
properties.description: Returns the path to the Library folder, but without the final separator. Read-only String.

properties.name: MailSession
properties.description: Returns the MAPI mail session number as a hexadecimal string (if there's an active session), or returns null if there's no session. Read-only Variant.

properties.name: MailSystem
properties.description: Returns the mail system that's installed on the host machine. Read-only XlMailSystem.

properties.name: MathCoprocessorAvailable
properties.description: True if a math coprocessor is available. Read-only Boolean.

properties.name: MaxChange
properties.description: Returns or sets the maximum amount of change between each iteration as Microsoft Excel resolves circular references. Read/write Double.

properties.name: MaxIterations
properties.description: Returns or sets the maximum number of iterations that Microsoft Excel can use to resolve a circular reference. Read/write Long.

properties.name: MouseAvailable
properties.description: True if a mouse is available. Read-only Boolean.

properties.name: MoveAfterReturn
properties.description: True if the active cell is moved as soon as the Enter (Return) key is pressed. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: MoveAfterReturnDirection
properties.description: Returns or sets the direction in which the active cell is moved when the user presses Enter. Read/write XlDirection.

properties.name: RecentFiles
properties.description: Returns a RecentFiles collection that represents the list of recently used files.

properties.name: Name
properties.description: Returns a String value that represents the name of the object.

properties.name: NetworkTemplatesPath
properties.description: Returns the network path where templates are stored. If the network path doesn't exist, this property returns an empty string. Read-only String.

properties.name: ODBCErrors
properties.description: Returns an ODBCErrors collection that contains all the ODBC errors generated by the most recent query table or PivotTable report operation. Read-only.

properties.name: ODBCTimeout
properties.description: Returns or sets the ODBC query time limit, in seconds. The default value is 45 seconds. Read/write Long.

properties.name: OnWindow
properties.description: Returns or sets the name of the procedure that's run whenever you activate a window. Read/write String.

properties.name: OperatingSystem
properties.description: Returns the name and version number of the current operating system. Read-only String.

properties.name: OrganizationName
properties.description: Returns the registered organization name. Read-only String.

properties.name: Path
properties.description: Returns a String value that represents the complete path to the application, excluding the final separator and name of the application.

properties.name: PathSeparator
properties.description: Returns the path separator character (\). Read-only String.

properties.name: PreviousSelections
properties.description: Returns an array of the last four ranges or names selected. Each element in the array is a Range object. Read-only Variant.

properties.name: PivotTableSelection
properties.description: True if PivotTable reports use structured selection. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: PromptForSummaryInfo
properties.description: True if Microsoft Excel asks for summary information when files are first saved. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: RecordRelative
properties.description: True if macros are recorded by using relative references; False if recording is absolute. Read-only Boolean.

properties.name: ReferenceStyle
properties.description: Returns or sets how Microsoft Excel displays cell references and row and column headings in either A1 or R1C1 reference style. Read/write XlReferenceStyle.

properties.name: RegisteredFunctions
properties.description: Returns information about functions in either dynamic-link libraries (DLLs) or code resources that were registered with the REGISTER or REGISTER.ID macro functions. Read-only Variant.

properties.name: RollZoom
properties.description: True if the IntelliMouse zooms instead of scrolling. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: ScreenUpdating
properties.description: True if screen updating is turned on. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: SheetsInNewWorkbook
properties.description: Returns or sets the number of sheets that Microsoft Excel automatically inserts into new workbooks. Read/write Long.

properties.name: ShowChartTipNames
properties.description: True if charts show chart tip names. The default value is True. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: ShowChartTipValues
properties.description: True if charts show chart tip values. The default value is True. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: StandardFont
properties.description: Returns or sets the name of the standard font. Read/write String.

properties.name: StandardFontSize
properties.description: Returns or sets the standard font size, in points. Read/write Long.

properties.name: StartupPath
properties.description: Returns the complete path of the startup folder, excluding the final separator. Read-only String.

properties.name: StatusBar
properties.description: Returns or sets the text in the status bar. Read/write String.

properties.name: TemplatesPath
properties.description: Returns the local path where templates are stored. Read-only String.

properties.name: ShowToolTips
properties.description: True if ToolTips are turned on. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: Top
properties.description: Returns or sets a Double value that represents the distance, in points, from the top edge of the screen to the top edge of the main Microsoft Excel window.

properties.name: DefaultSaveFormat
properties.description: Returns or sets the default format for saving files. For a list of valid constants, see the FileFormat property. Read/write Long.

properties.name: TransitionMenuKey
properties.description: Returns or sets the Microsoft Excel menu or help key, which is usually /. Read/write String.

properties.name: TransitionMenuKeyAction
properties.description: Returns or sets the action taken when the Microsoft Excel menu key is pressed. Can be either xlExcelMenus or xlLotusHelp (see the Excel constants enumeration). Read/write Long.

properties.name: TransitionNavigKeys
properties.description: True if transition navigation keys are active. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: UsableHeight
properties.description: Returns the maximum height of the space that a window can occupy in the application window area, in points. Read-only Double.

properties.name: UsableWidth
properties.description: Returns the maximum width of the space that a window can occupy in the application window area, in points. Read-only Double.

properties.name: UserControl
properties.description: True if the application is visible or if it was created or started by the user. False if you created or started the application programmatically by using the CreateObject or GetObject functions, and the application is hidden. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: UserName
properties.description: Returns or sets the name of the current user. Read/write String.

properties.name: Value
properties.description: Returns a String value that represents the name of the application.

properties.name: VBE
properties.description: Returns a VBE object that represents the Visual Basic Editor. Read-only.

properties.name: Version
properties.description: Returns a String value that represents the Microsoft Excel version number.

properties.name: Visible
properties.description: Returns or sets a Boolean value that determines whether the object is visible. Read/write.

properties.name: Width
properties.description: Returns or sets a Double value that represents the distance, in points, from the left edge of the application window to its right edge.

properties.name: WindowsForPens
properties.description: True if the computer is running under Microsoft Windows for Pen Computing. Read-only Boolean.

properties.name: WindowState
properties.description: Returns or sets the state of the window. Read/write XlWindowState.

properties.name: DefaultSheetDirection
properties.description: Returns or sets the default direction in which Microsoft Excel displays new windows and worksheets. Can be one of the following XlReadingOrder constants: xlRTL (right to left) or xlLTR (left to right). Read/write Long.

properties.name: CursorMovement
properties.description: Returns or sets a value that indicates whether a visual cursor or a logical cursor is used. Can be one of the following constants: xlVisualCursor or xlLogicalCursor. Read/write Long.

properties.name: ControlCharacters
properties.description: True if Microsoft Excel displays control characters for right-to-left languages. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: EnableEvents
properties.description: True if events are enabled for the specified object. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: ExtendList
properties.description: True if Microsoft Excel automatically extends formatting and formulas to new data that is added to a list. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: OLEDBErrors
properties.description: Returns the OLEDBErrors collection, which represents the error information returned by the most recent OLE DB query. Read-only.

properties.name: COMAddIns
properties.description: Returns the COMAddIns collection for Microsoft Excel, which represents the currently installed COM add-ins. Read-only.

properties.name: DefaultWebOptions
properties.description: Returns the DefaultWebOptions object that contains global application-level attributes used by Microsoft Excel whenever you save a document as a webpage or open a webpage. Read-only.

properties.name: ProductCode
properties.description: Returns the globally unique identifier (GUID) for Microsoft Excel. Read-only String.

properties.name: UserLibraryPath
properties.description: Returns the path to the location on the user's computer where the COM add-ins are installed. Read-only String.

properties.name: AutoPercentEntry
properties.description: True if entries in cells formatted as percentages aren't automatically multiplied by 100 as soon as they are entered. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: LanguageSettings
properties.description: Returns the LanguageSettings object, which contains information about the language settings in Microsoft Excel. Read-only.

properties.name: CalculationVersion
properties.description: Returns a number whose rightmost four digits are the minor calculation engine version number, and whose other digits (on the left) are the major version of Microsoft Excel. Read-only Long.

properties.name: FeatureInstall
properties.description: Returns or sets a value (constant) that specifies how Microsoft Excel handles calls to methods and properties that require features that aren't yet installed. Can be one of the MsoFeatureInstall constants listed in the following table. Read/write MsoFeatureInstall.

properties.name: Ready
properties.description: Returns True when the Microsoft Excel application is ready; False when the Excel application is not ready. Read-only Boolean.

properties.name: FindFormat
properties.description: Sets or returns the search criteria for the type of cell formats to find.

properties.name: ReplaceFormat
properties.description: Sets the replacement criteria to use in replacing cell formats. The replacement criteria is then used in a subsequent call to the Replace method of the Range object.

properties.name: UsedObjects
properties.description: Returns a UsedObjects object representing objects allocated in a workbook. Read-only.

properties.name: CalculationState
properties.description: Returns an XlCalculationState constant that indicates the calculation state of the application, for any calculations that are being performed in Microsoft Excel. Read-only.

properties.name: CalculationInterruptKey
properties.description: Sets or returns an XlCalculationInterruptKey constant that specifies the key that can interrupt Microsoft Excel when performing calculations. Read/write.

properties.name: Watches
properties.description: Returns a Watches object representing a range that is tracked when the worksheet is recalculated.

properties.name: DisplayFunctionToolTips
properties.description: True if function ToolTips can be displayed. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: AutomationSecurity
properties.description: Returns or sets an MsoAutomationSecurity constant that represents the security mode that Microsoft Excel uses when programmatically opening files. Read/write.

properties.name: FileDialog
properties.description: Returns a FileDialog object representing an instance of the file dialog.

properties.name: DisplayPasteOptions
properties.description: True if the Paste Options button can be displayed. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: DisplayInsertOptions
properties.description: True if the Insert Options button should be displayed. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: GenerateGetPivotData
properties.description: Returns True when Microsoft Excel can get PivotTable report data. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: AutoRecover
properties.description: Returns an AutoRecover object, which backs up all file formats on a timed interval.

properties.name: Hwnd
properties.description: Returns a Long indicating the top-level window handle of the Microsoft Excel window. Read-only.

properties.name: Hinstance
properties.description: Returns a handle to the instance of Excel represented by the Application object. Read-only Long.

properties.name: ErrorCheckingOptions
properties.description: Returns an ErrorCheckingOptions object, which represents the error checking options for an application.

properties.name: AutoFormatAsYouTypeReplaceHyperlinks
properties.description: True (default) if Microsoft Excel automatically formats hyperlinks as you type. False if Excel does not automatically format hyperlinks as you type. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: NewWorkbook
properties.description: Returns a NewFile object.

properties.name: SpellingOptions
properties.description: Returns a SpellingOptions object that represents the spelling options of the application.

properties.name: Speech
properties.description: Returns a Speech object.

properties.name: MapPaperSize
properties.description: True if documents formatted for the standard paper size of another country/region (for example, A4) are automatically adjusted so that they're printed correctly on the standard paper size (for example, Letter) of your country/region. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: ShowStartupDialog
properties.description: Returns True (default is False) when the New Workbook task pane appears for a Microsoft Excel application. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: DecimalSeparator
properties.description: Sets or returns the character used for the decimal separator as a String. Read/write.

properties.name: ThousandsSeparator
properties.description: Sets or returns the character used for the thousands separator as a String. Read/write.

properties.name: UseSystemSeparators
properties.description: True (default) if the system separators of Microsoft Excel are enabled. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: ThisCell
properties.description: Returns the cell in which the user-defined function is being called from as a Range object.

properties.name: RTD

properties.description: Returns or sets the worksheet range linked to the control's value. If you place a value in the cell, the control takes this value. Likewise, if you change the value of the control, that value is also placed in the cell. Read/write String.

properties.description: Returns the number of entries in a list box or combo box. Returns 0 (zero) if there are no entries in the list. Read-only Long.

properties.description: Indicates whether the OLAP cube field is a hierarchy field or a measure field. Can be one of the XlCubeFieldType constants.

properties.name: Name
properties.description: Returns a String value that represents the name of the object.

properties.name: Value
properties.description: Returns a String value that represents the name of the specified field.

properties.name: Orientation
properties.description: Returns or sets an XlPivotFieldOrientation value that represents the location of the field in the specified PivotTable report.

properties.name: Position
properties.description: Returns or sets a Long value that represents the position of the hierarchy field on the PivotTable report when it's dragged from the field well.

properties.name: TreeviewControl
properties.description: Returns the TreeviewControl object of the CubeField object, representing the cube manipulation control of an OLAP-based PivotTable report. Read-only.

properties.name: DragToColumn
properties.description: True if the specified field can be dragged to the column position. The default value is True. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: DragToHide
properties.description: True if the field can be hidden by being dragged off the PivotTable report. The default value is True. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: DragToPage
properties.description: True if the field can be dragged to the page position. The default value is True. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: DragToRow
properties.description: True if the field can be dragged to the row position. The default value is True. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: DragToData
properties.description: True if the specified field can be dragged to the data position. The default value is True. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: HasMemberProperties
properties.description: Returns True when there are member properties specified to be displayed for the cube field. Read-only Boolean.

properties.name: LayoutForm
properties.description: Returns or sets the way the specified PivotTable items appear-in table format or in outline format. Read/write XlLayoutFormType.

properties.name: PivotFields
properties.description: Returns the PivotFields collection. This collection contains all PivotTable fields, including those that aren't currently visible on-screen. Read-only PivotFields object.

properties.name: EnableMultiplePageItems
properties.description: Set to True to allow multiple items in the page field area for OLAP PivotTables to be selected. The default value is False. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: LayoutSubtotalLocation
properties.description: Returns or sets the position of the PivotTable field subtotals in relation to (either above or below) the specified field. Read/write XlSubtotalLocationType.

properties.name: ShowInFieldList
properties.description: When set to True (default), a CubeField object will be shown in the field list. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: IncludeNewItemsInFilter
properties.description: The IncludeNewItemsInFilter property is used to track included/excluded items in OLAP PivotTables. Read/write.

properties.name: CubeFieldSubType
properties.description: Specifies the type of a CubeField. Read-only.

properties.name: AllItemsVisible
properties.description: The AllItemsVisible property checks whether manual filtering is applied to a PivotField or CubeField. Read-only Boolean.

properties.name: CurrentPageName
properties.description: Returns or sets the page name for a CubeField. Read/write String.

properties.name: IsDate
properties.description: Returns True if the CubeField is a date. Read-only Boolean.

properties.name: Caption
properties.description: Returns a String value that represents the label text for the cube field.

properties.name: FlattenHierarchies
properties.description: Returns or sets whether items from all levels of hierarchies in a named set cube field are displayed in the same field of a PivotTable report based on an OLAP cube. Read/write.

properties.name: HierarchizeDistinct
properties.description: Returns or sets whether to order and remove duplicates when displaying the specified named set in a PivotTable report based on an OLAP cube. Read/write.

Microsoft Excel creates a cascading style sheet file and saves it either to the specified folder or to the same folder as your webpage, depending on the value of the OrganizeInFolder property. properties.name: SaveHiddenData
properties.description: True if data outside of the specified range is saved when you save the document as a webpage. This data may be necessary for maintaining formulas. False if data outside of the specified range is not saved with the webpage. The default value is True. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: LoadPictures
properties.description: True if images are loaded when you open a document in Microsoft Excel, usually when the images and document were not created in Microsoft Excel. False if the images are not loaded. The default value is True. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: OrganizeInFolder
properties.description: True if all supporting files, such as background textures and graphics, are organized in a separate folder when you save the specified document as a webpage. False if supporting files are saved in the same folder as the webpage. The default value is True. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: UpdateLinksOnSave
properties.description: True if hyperlinks and paths to all supporting files are automatically updated before you save the document as a webpage, ensuring that the links are up to date at the time the document is saved. False if the links are not updated. The default value is True. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: UseLongFileNames

properties.name: RelyOnVML

properties.name: AllowPNG

properties.name: Encoding

properties.name: Cells
properties.description: Returns a Range object that represents the cells in the specified range.

properties.name: Characters
properties.description: Returns a Characters object that represents a range of characters within the object text. Use the Characters object to format characters within a text string.

properties.name: Column
properties.description: Returns the number of the first column in the first area in the specified range. Read-only Long.

properties.name: Columns
properties.description: Returns a Range object that represents the columns in the specified range.

properties.name: ColumnWidth
properties.description: Returns or sets the width of all columns in the specified range. Read/write Double.

properties.name: Count
properties.description: Returns a Long value that represents the number of objects in the collection.

properties.name: CurrentArray
properties.description: If the specified cell is part of an array, returns a Range object that represents the entire array. Read-only.

properties.name: CurrentRegion
properties.description: Returns a Range object that represents the current region. The current region is a range bounded by any combination of blank rows and blank columns. Read-only.

properties.name: Dependents
properties.description: Returns a Range object that represents the range containing all the dependents of a cell. This can be a multiple selection (a union of Range objects) if there's more than one dependent. Read-only Range object.

properties.name: DirectDependents
properties.description: Returns a Range object that represents the range containing all the direct dependents of a cell. This can be a multiple selection (a union of Range objects) if there's more than one dependent. Read-only Range object.

properties.name: DirectPrecedents
properties.description: Returns a Range object that represents the range containing all the direct precedents of a cell. This can be a multiple selection (a union of Range objects) if there's more than one precedent. Read-only Range object.

properties.name: End
properties.description: Returns a Range object that represents the cell at the end of the region that contains the source range. Equivalent to pressing END+UP ARROW, END+DOWN ARROW, END+LEFT ARROW, or END+RIGHT ARROW. Read-only Range object.

properties.name: EntireColumn

properties.name: EntireRow

properties.name: IndentLevel

properties.name: Interior

properties.name: Item
properties.description: Returns a Range object that represents a range at an offset to the specified range.

properties.name: Left

properties.name: ListHeaderRows
properties.description: Returns the number of header rows for the specified range. Read-only Long.

properties.name: LocationInTable
properties.description: Returns a constant that describes the part of the PivotTable report that contains the upper-left corner of the specified range. Can be one of the following XlLocationInTable constants. Read-only Long.

properties.name: Locked
properties.description: Returns or sets a Variant value that indicates if the object is locked.

properties.name: MergeArea
properties.description: Returns a Range object that represents the merged range containing the specified cell. If the specified cell isn't in a merged range, this property returns the specified cell. Read-only Variant.

properties.name: MergeCells
properties.description: True if the range contains merged cells. Read/write Variant.

properties.name: Name
properties.description: Returns or sets a Variant value that represents the name of the object.

properties.name: Next

properties.name: NumberFormat
properties.description: Returns or sets a Variant value that represents the format code for the object.

properties.name: NumberFormatLocal

properties.name: Offset

properties.name: Orientation
properties.description: Returns or sets a Variant value that represents the text orientation.

properties.name: OutlineLevel
properties.description: Returns or sets the current outline level of the specified row or column. Read/write Variant.

properties.name: PageBreak
properties.description: Returns or sets the location of a page break. Can be one of the following XlPageBreak constants: xlPageBreakAutomatic, xlPageBreakManual, or xlPageBreakNone. Read/write Long.

properties.name: PivotField
properties.description: Returns a PivotField object that represents the PivotTable field containing the upper-left corner of the specified range.

properties.name: PivotItem
properties.description: Returns a PivotItem object that represents the PivotTable item containing the upper-left corner of the specified range.

properties.name: PivotTable

properties.name: Precedents

properties.name: PrefixCharacter
properties.description: Returns the prefix character for the cell. Read-only Variant.

properties.name: Previous

properties.name: QueryTable

properties.name: Range

properties.name: RowHeight
properties.description: Returns or sets the height of the first row in the range specified, measured in points. Read/write Double.

properties.name: Rows
properties.description: Returns a Range object that represents the rows in the specified range.

properties.name: ShowDetail
properties.description: True if the outline is expanded for the specified range (so that the detail of the column or row is visible). The specified range must be a single summary column or row in an outline. Read/write Variant.

properties.name: ShrinkToFit
properties.description: Returns or sets a Variant value that indicates if text automatically shrinks to fit in the available column width.

properties.name: Style

properties.name: Summary
properties.description: True if the range is an outlining summary row or column. The range should be a row or a column. Read-only Variant.

properties.name: Text
properties.description: Returns the formatted text for the specified object. Read-only String.

properties.name: Top
properties.description: Returns a Variant value that represents the distance, in points, from the top edge of row 1 to the top edge of the range.

properties.name: UseStandardHeight
properties.description: True if the row height of the Range object equals the standard height of the sheet. Returns Null if the range contains more than one row and the rows aren't all the same height. Read/write Variant.

properties.name: UseStandardWidth
properties.description: True if the column width of the Range object equals the standard width of the sheet. Returns null if the range contains more than one column and the columns aren't all the same width. Read/write Variant.

properties.name: Validation

properties.name: Value

properties.name: Value2

properties.name: VerticalAlignment

properties.name: Width

properties.name: Worksheet

properties.name: WrapText
properties.description: Returns or sets a Variant value that indicates if Microsoft Excel wraps the text in the object.

properties.name: Comment

properties.name: Phonetic

properties.name: FormatConditions

properties.name: ReadingOrder
properties.description: Returns or sets the reading order for the specified object. Can be one of the following XlReadingOrder constants: xlRTL (right-to-left), xlLTR (left-to-right), or xlContext. Read/write Long.

properties.name: Hyperlinks

properties.name: Phonetics

properties.name: ListObject

properties.name: XPath

properties.name: MDX

properties.name: CountLarge
properties.description: Returns a value that represents the number of objects in the collection. Read-only Variant.

properties.name: SparklineGroups

properties.name: DisplayFormat

properties.name: HasRichDataType
properties.description: True if all cells in the range contain a Rich data type. False if none of the cells in the range contains a Rich data type; otherwise, null. Read-only Variant.

properties.name: CommentThreaded

properties.name: LinkedDataTypeState
properties.description: Returns information about the state of any Linked data types, such as Stocks or Geography, in the range. Possible values are from the XlLinkedDataTypeState enumeration. Read-only.

properties.name: HasSpill

properties.name: Formula2R1C1Local
properties.description: This is the Formula2 Variant of Range.FormulaR1C1Local. See Range.Formula2 and Range.FormulaR1C1Local for more detail.

properties.name: SavedAsArray
properties.description: True if all of the cells in the range would be saved to file as an array formula; False if none of the cells in the range would be saved to file as a legacy array formula; null otherwise. Read-only Variant.

properties.name: Name
properties.description: Returns or sets the name of the WorkbookConnection object. Read/write String.

properties.name: Description
properties.description: Returns or sets a brief description for a WorkbookConnection object. Read/write String.

properties.name: Type
properties.description: Returns the workbook connection type. Read-only XlConnectionType.

properties.name: OLEDBConnection
properties.description: Returns the OLEDB connection details for the specified WorkbookConnection object. Read-only OLEDBConnection.

properties.name: ODBCConnection
properties.description: Returns the ODBC connection details for the specified WorkbookConnection object. Read-only ODBCConnection.

properties.name: Ranges
properties.description: Returns the range of objects for the specified WorkbookConnection object. Read-only Ranges.

properties.name: ModelConnection
properties.description: Returns an object that contains information for the new model connection type introduced in Excel 2013 to interact with the integrated Data Model. Read-only.

properties.name: WorksheetDataConnection
properties.description: Returns an object that contains information for a connection from the PowerPivot Model to data within the workbook, such as a range, named range, or table. Read-only.

properties.name: RefreshWithRefreshAll
properties.description: Determines if the connection should be refreshed when Refresh All is executed. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: TextConnection
properties.description: Returns a TextConnection object that contains the information on a query to a text file. Read-only.

properties.name: DataFeedConnection
properties.description: Returns a DataFeedConnection object that contains the data and functionality needed to connect to data feeds. Read-only.

properties.name: InModel
properties.description: Specifies whether the WorkbookConnection has been added to the model. Read-only Boolean.

properties.name: ModelTables
properties.description: Returns a ModelTables object associated with the particular connection. Read-only.

properties.description: Returns a Long value that represents the index number of the object within the collection of similar objects.

properties.description: Returns or sets a String value that represents the object name.

properties.name: Next
properties.description: Returns a Worksheet object that represents the next sheet.

properties.name: PageSetup
properties.description: Returns a PageSetup object that contains all the page setup settings for the specified object. Read-only.

properties.name: Previous
properties.description: Returns a Worksheet object that represents the previous sheet.

properties.name: ProtectContents
properties.description: True if the contents of the sheet are protected. This protects the individual cells. To turn on content protection, use the Protect method with the Contents argument set to True. Read-only Boolean.

properties.name: ProtectDrawingObjects
properties.description: True if shapes are protected. To turn on shape protection, use the Protect method with the DrawingObjects argument set to True. Read-only Boolean.

properties.name: ProtectionMode
properties.description: True if user-interface-only protection is turned on. To turn on user interface protection, use the Protect method with the UserInterfaceOnly argument set to True. Read-only Boolean.

properties.name: ProtectScenarios
properties.description: True if the worksheet scenarios are protected. Read-only Boolean.

properties.name: Visible
properties.description: Returns or sets an XlSheetVisibility value that determines whether the object is visible.

properties.name: Shapes
properties.description: Returns a Shapes collection that represents all the shapes on the worksheet. Read-only.

properties.name: TransitionExpEval
properties.description: True if Microsoft Excel uses Lotus 1-2-3 expression evaluation rules for the worksheet. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: AutoFilterMode
properties.description: True if the AutoFilter drop-down arrows are currently displayed on the sheet. This property is independent of the FilterMode property. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: EnableCalculation
properties.description: True if Microsoft Excel automatically recalculates the worksheet when necessary. False if Excel doesn't recalculate the sheet. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: Cells
properties.description: Returns a Range object that represents all the cells on the worksheet (not just the cells that are currently in use).

properties.name: CircularReference
properties.description: Returns a Range object that represents the range containing the first circular reference on the sheet, or returns Nothing if there's no circular reference on the sheet. The circular reference must be removed before calculation can proceed.

properties.name: Columns
properties.description: Returns a Range object that represents all the columns on the specified worksheet.

properties.name: ConsolidationFunction
properties.description: Returns the function code used for the current consolidation. Can be one of the constants of XlConsolidationFunction. Read-only Long.

properties.name: ConsolidationOptions
properties.description: Returns a three-element array of consolidation options, as shown in the following table. If the element is True, that option is set. Read-only Variant.

properties.name: ConsolidationSources
properties.description: Returns an array of string values that name the source sheets for the worksheet's current consolidation. Returns Empty if there's no consolidation on the sheet. Read-only Variant.

properties.name: EnableAutoFilter
properties.description: True if AutoFilter arrows are enabled when user-interface-only protection is turned on. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: EnableSelection
properties.description: Returns or sets what can be selected on the sheet. Read/write XlEnableSelection.

properties.name: EnableOutlining
properties.description: True if outlining symbols are enabled when user-interface-only protection is turned on. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: EnablePivotTable
properties.description: True if PivotTable controls and actions are enabled when user-interface-only protection is turned on. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: FilterMode
properties.description: True if the worksheet is in the filter mode. Read-only Boolean.

properties.name: Names
properties.description: Returns a Names collection that represents all the worksheet-specific names (names defined with the "WorksheetName!" prefix). Read-only Names object.

properties.name: Outline
properties.description: Returns an Outline object that represents the outline for the specified worksheet. Read-only.

properties.name: Range
properties.description: Returns a Range object that represents a cell or a range of cells.

properties.name: Rows
properties.description: Returns a Range object that represents all the rows on the specified worksheet.

properties.name: ScrollArea
properties.description: Returns or sets the range where scrolling is allowed, as an A1-style range reference. Cells outside the scroll area cannot be selected. Read/write String.

properties.name: StandardHeight
properties.description: Returns the standard (default) height of all the rows on the worksheet, in points. Read-only Double.

properties.name: StandardWidth
properties.description: Returns or sets the standard (default) width of all the columns on the worksheet. Read/write Double.

properties.name: TransitionFormEntry
properties.description: True if Microsoft Excel uses Lotus 1-2-3 formula entry rules for the worksheet. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: Type
properties.description: Returns an XlSheetType value that represents the worksheet type.

properties.name: UsedRange
properties.description: Returns a Range object that represents the used range on the specified worksheet. Read-only.

properties.name: HPageBreaks
properties.description: Returns an HPageBreaks collection that represents the horizontal page breaks on the sheet. Read-only.

properties.name: VPageBreaks
properties.description: Returns a VPageBreaks collection that represents the vertical page breaks on the sheet. Read-only.

properties.name: QueryTables
properties.description: Returns the QueryTables collection that represents all the query tables on the specified worksheet. Read-only.

properties.name: DisplayPageBreaks
properties.description: True if page breaks (both automatic and manual) on the specified worksheet are displayed. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: Comments
properties.description: Returns a Comments collection that represents all the comments for the specified worksheet. Read-only.

properties.name: Hyperlinks
properties.description: Returns a Hyperlinks collection that represents the hyperlinks for the worksheet.

properties.name: DisplayRightToLeft
properties.description: True if the specified worksheet is displayed from right to left instead of from left to right. False if the object is displayed from left to right. Read-only Boolean.

properties.name: Tab
properties.description: Returns a Tab object for a worksheet.

properties.name: MailEnvelope
properties.description: Represents an email header for a document.

properties.name: CustomProperties
properties.description: Returns a CustomProperties object representing the identifier information associated with a worksheet.

properties.name: Protection
properties.description: Returns a Protection object that represents the protection options of the worksheet.

properties.name: ListObjects
properties.description: Returns a collection of ListObject objects on the worksheet. Read-only ListObjects collection.

properties.name: EnableFormatConditionsCalculation
properties.description: Returns or sets if conditional formats occur automatically as needed. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: PrintedCommentPages
properties.description: Returns the number of comment pages that will be printed for the current worksheet. Read-only.

properties.name: CommentsThreaded
properties.description: Returns a CommentsThreaded collection that represents all the top-level/root comments (no replies) for the specified worksheet. Includes legacy and modern comments. Read-only.

properties.name: AutoFilter
properties.description: Returns an AutoFilter object if filtering is on. Read-only.

properties.name: Sort
properties.description: Returns a Sort object. Read-only.

properties.description: Returns or sets whether to display a dialog box that details schema-validation errors when data is imported or exported through the specified XML schema map. The default value is False. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: SaveDataSourceDefinition
properties.description: True if the data source definition of the specified XML schema map is saved with the workbook. The default value is True. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: AdjustColumnWidth

properties.name: PreserveColumnFilter

properties.name: PreserveNumberFormatting
properties.description: True if number formatting on cells mapped to the specified XML schema map are preserved when the schema map is refreshed. The default value is False. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: AppendOnImport
properties.description: True if you want to append new rows to XML lists that are bound to the specified schema map when you are importing new data or refreshing an existing connection.

properties.name: Schemas

properties.name: DataBinding
